members.name: routing
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which specific issue is the customer raising? Pick the option that best matches the customer's main request.

criteria.unrecognised_card_payment: An unknown charge or card payment on the account that the customer doesn't recognise or didn't make
criteria.unrecognised_cash_withdrawal: A cash/ATM withdrawal the customer doesn't recognise or didn't make
criteria.unrecognised_direct_debit: A direct debit the customer doesn't recognise or didn't authorise
criteria.compromised_card: Card details may be compromised, someone else may have used the card, suspected fraud on card
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card lost or stolen, reporting it, or found a card after reporting it lost
criteria.unexpected_money: Money appeared in or disappeared from the account that the customer didn't put there or take out
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN blocked or not working, card locked after wrong PIN attempts, unblocking the PIN
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone lost, stolen or left somewhere; using or protecting the app/account without the phone
criteria.request_refund: Wants a refund for a purchase, how to get a refund, the refund process
criteria.refund_not_showing: A refund from a merchant isn't showing on the account/statement yet
criteria.charged_twice: The same transaction was charged twice / duplicate charge
criteria.wrong_cash_amount: The customer didn't get the amount of cash they wanted/requested from the ATM: it dispensed less (or more) cash
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A card payment was cancelled, reverted or returned to the account; why a card payment would be cancelled
criteria.cancel_purchase: Wants to cancel an order or purchase from a merchant, e.g. goods not received
criteria.activate_card: How to activate a new card
criteria.card_arrival: Card hasn't arrived yet, tracking card delivery, how long card delivery takes
criteria.card_linking: Linking a card to the app or account, adding an existing card
criteria.card_not_working: Physical card isn't working, stopped working, broken or damaged card
criteria.card_expiry: Card about to expire, replacement card, renewal
criteria.card_acceptance: Whether particular shops or merchants accept the card
criteria.change_pin: Changing, resetting or updating the card PIN, where the PIN can be changed
criteria.find_pin: Where to find the PIN for a new card, PIN not received yet, the customer doesn't have a PIN
criteria.declined_card_payment: The card was declined or refused at the moment of paying in a shop or online
criteria.order_card: Ordering a physical card, a spare/additional card, or a new card
criteria.virtual_card: Getting a virtual card or disposable virtual card, their limits, or virtual card not working
criteria.visa_mastercard: Which cards the bank offers or carries and choosing which card to get: Visa or Mastercard, whether the customer can choose their card, or whether Visa and Mastercard cards can be used
criteria.apple_google_pay: Using Apple Pay or Google Pay with the card
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs can be used, how to use the card at an ATM
criteria.transfer_not_received: A transfer sent but the recipient hasn't received it
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take, when a transfer will arrive
criteria.failed_or_declined_transfer: A transfer failed, was declined, or didn't go through
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Unable to add a beneficiary/payee or send to a particular beneficiary
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel, stop or reverse a transfer, transaction or payment they made, sent money to the wrong account
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving money, salary or incoming transfers into the account, how to get paid
criteria.balance_not_updated: Balance not updated after a bank transfer, cheque or cash deposit
criteria.pending_card_payment: A payment still showing as pending, or taking long to go through
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal still showing as pending, not yet showing, or the balance doesn't look right after an ATM withdrawal
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: ATM cash withdrawal was declined, the card didn't work at the ATM, or the ATM wouldn't let the customer withdraw
criteria.top_up_how: How to top up / add money to the account: by bank transfer, cash, cheque, Apple/Google Pay, deposit (not which cards are accepted)
criteria.top_up_problem: A top-up that is pending, failed, was reverted, or didn't show up
criteria.money_limits: Daily or other limits on how much money the customer can top up, spend, withdraw or transfer (not fee-free allowances)
criteria.transfer_with_card: Making a transfer or payment using a credit card
criteria.transaction_record: Receipts, confirmations or records for a payment or money transaction the customer made
criteria.direct_debit_setup: Setting up or using direct debits and standing orders
criteria.card_payment_fee: A fee charged on a card payment, purchase or transaction that went through, including purchases from abroad
criteria.atm_fee: Fees for cash withdrawals at ATMs, including how much can be withdrawn without fees
criteria.transfer_fee: Fees charged for transfers, including a recipient receiving less than the amount sent, or whether the full amount of a transfer will arrive
criteria.top_up_fee: Fees for topping up by card or bank transfer
criteria.extra_charge: An unexplained extra charge or amount (e.g. an extra £1) seen on the statement or app
criteria.exchange_rate: Exchange rates, wrong exchange rate applied to a payment or withdrawal
criteria.currency_exchange_in_app: How to exchange currencies in the app, holding multiple currencies
criteria.supported_cards_currencies: Which currencies (fiat) are supported, which cards (e.g. American Express, credit cards, other cards) can be used to top up or add money, and which transfer types (e.g. SWIFT) are available
criteria.verify_identity: Identity verification: how to verify, why it's needed, verification failing
criteria.source_of_funds: Source of funds: where the money in the customer's account comes from, who is giving them their money, proving the origin of funds
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up card / verification code for a top-up
criteria.edit_details: Changing personal details: name, address, phone, email
criteria.country_support: Which countries are supported: whether the service can be used or signed up for in a given country, abroad or all over the world
criteria.passcode: Forgotten app passcode or login password, can't log in
criteria.account_safety_general: General questions about how the bank protects customers' money and accounts (not reporting a specific incident)
criteria.open_account: Opening an account and general account questions
